en.name: Jellyfish
en.description: A soft, translucent clump that forms where gravitational anomalies have folded on themselves. Slightly warm to the touch and always a little lighter than it should be. Common near Vortex fields.

ru.name: Медуза
ru.description: A soft, translucent clump that forms where gravitational anomalies have folded on themselves. Slightly warm to the touch and always a little lighter than it should be. Common near Vortex fields.

en.name: Stone Blood
en.description: A dense reddish-brown lump of fused soil, leaves and something that might once have been bone. Born in chemical anomalies; scientists pay well for samples.

ru.name: Каменная кровь
ru.description: A dense reddish-brown lump of fused soil, leaves and something that might once have been bone. Born in chemical anomalies; scientists pay well for samples.

en.name: Sparkler
en.description: A tangle of metallic filaments that crackles with static. Found near Electro anomalies after a discharge. Don't keep it next to your radio.

ru.name: Бенгальский огонь
ru.description: A tangle of metallic filaments that crackles with static. Found near Electro anomalies after a discharge. Don't keep it next to your radio.

en.name: Slime
en.description: A quivering greenish mass that never quite settles. Thrown off by acidic Fruit Punch pools. Seals well in a glass jar - mostly.

ru.name: Слизь
ru.description: A quivering greenish mass that never quite settles. Thrown off by acidic Fruit Punch pools. Seals well in a glass jar - mostly.

en.name: Moonlight
en.description: A perfectly round sphere that glows with a pale, steady light in the dark. Forms in Electro anomalies. Psy-researchers believe it dampens the effect of psi-emissions.

ru.name: Лунный свет
ru.description: A perfectly round sphere that glows with a pale, steady light in the dark. Forms in Electro anomalies. Psy-researchers believe it dampens the effect of psi-emissions.

en.name: Flash
en.description: Lightning caught in glass. Every few seconds it flickers as if something inside is trying to get out. Highly prized by electronics smugglers.

ru.name: Вспышка
ru.description: Lightning caught in glass. Every few seconds it flickers as if something inside is trying to get out. Highly prized by electronics smugglers.

en.name: Thorn
en.description: A cluster of hard, needle-like spines grown around a seed of unknown origin. It draws blood from anyone who handles it carelessly - and seems to like it.

ru.name: Колючка
ru.description: A cluster of hard, needle-like spines grown around a seed of unknown origin. It draws blood from anyone who handles it carelessly - and seems to like it.

en.name: Fireball
en.description: A heavy, egg-shaped stone that stays hot no matter how long it's been out of the Burner. Stalkers carry them through winter to keep their hands working.

ru.name: Огненный шар
ru.description: A heavy, egg-shaped stone that stays hot no matter how long it's been out of the Burner. Stalkers carry them through winter to keep their hands working.

en.name: Night Star
en.description: A gravitational artifact that glows faintly in rhythmic pulses, like a slow heartbeat. Makes everything you carry feel lighter. Only forms deep inside Springboard fields.

ru.name: Ночная звезда
ru.description: A gravitational artifact that glows faintly in rhythmic pulses, like a slow heartbeat. Makes everything you carry feel lighter. Only forms deep inside Springboard fields.

en.name: Battery
en.description: Holds a charge that never seems to run out. Connect it to anything and it works - for a while. Ecologists want it badly; so does everyone else.

ru.name: Батарейка
ru.description: Holds a charge that never seems to run out. Connect it to anything and it works - for a while. Ecologists want it badly; so does everyone else.

en.name: Soul
en.description: An organic artifact shaped like a twisted, glowing flower. Wounds close faster near it. Nobody knows where it comes from, and those who find them rarely talk about it.

ru.name: Душа
ru.description: An organic artifact shaped like a twisted, glowing flower. Wounds close faster near it. Nobody knows where it comes from, and those who find them rarely talk about it.

en.name: Compass
en.description: A legend among stalkers. It is said to point to safe paths through any anomaly field - and that it was what let the first stalkers reach the Center. The Bunker has been looking for one for years.

ru.name: Компас
ru.description: A legend among stalkers. It is said to point to safe paths through any anomaly field - and that it was what let the first stalkers reach the Center. The Bunker has been looking for one for years.
